description: List the caller personas (profiles) in your workspace, newest first. Every mission-test config needs one: its `profileId` is a profile `id` from this list. Each profile has an `id`, a `name`, an optional `description`, and `items`: the named voice recordings and data values the caller can use, each with its `label`. Items are references (an `audioId`, or a `datasetId` and `itemId`), never the recorded audio or the data values themselves. Takes optional `limit` (1 to 1000, default 50). Use when: the user is setting up or drafting a mission test and has not said which persona to use, or asks which personas exist. Show people the profile `name`, not the `id`. If there is only one profile, it is the one to use. Cross-tool: to see which persona existing tests use, use listMissionTestConfigs (filter by `profileId`). Profiles are workspace-scoped.
name: listProfiles

items.description:
Workspace-scoped profile of named voice + data items, used to instantiate
parameterised tests. Items reference audio rows and/or dataset items via id.

id.description: Profile id (prefix `profile_` followed by a base-36 timestamp + random).

items.description:
Union of voice items (`type: voice`) and data items (`type: data`). The `type`
discriminator selects between `ProfileVoiceItem` and `ProfileDataItem`.

oneOf.description:
Voice item inside a profile — references an `AudioObject` by id. The `label` is
the parameter name used to match against test scripts.

audioId.description: Reference to `AudioObject.id` in the same workspace.

label.description:
Parameter label — used to match this profile against test configs that bind
to a parameter of the same name.

oneOf.description:
Data item inside a profile — references a specific `DataItem` inside a `Dataset`
by `datasetId` + `itemId`. The `label` is the parameter name used to match against
test scripts.

datasetId.description: Reference to `Dataset.id` in the same workspace.

title: List Caller Personas
